description:
Cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.


No more Japanese → Japanese "translations"
- When the detected source language is the same as your default target language (for example Japanese text with Japanese as the default target), the translator now picks a different target instead of translating into the same language: your writing target language if it differs, otherwise English. Applies to the translator window and the browser extension's inline lookup (#1873, thanks @hrtshu)
